<style id="ax-s130">
/* ============ Diagnostic workup, layout 5a (claude/design/WORKUP_5A_SPEC.md) ============ */
.lcp.w5a{display:block}
.w5a .w5z{margin:20px 2px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}
.w5a .w5t{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2),inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair)}
.w5a .w5t.first{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#F2F1FA 0%,#EDECF7 60%,#E9E8F4 100%);box-shadow:var(--e2),inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(84,74,196,.32)}
.w5a .w5b{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 24px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--recess);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--hair),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--hair)}
.w5a .w5t.first .w5b{background:#DEDEEB;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(84,74,196,.28)}
.w5a .w5c{min-width:0;padding-right:4px;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.3;color:var(--chart-ink);text-wrap:pretty}
.w5a .w5ar{text-align:center;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.w5a .w5o{min-width:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.005em;color:var(--ink)}
.w5a .w5o .w5ol{display:block}
.w5a .w5f{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 22px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:stretch;padding:0 14px}
.w5a .w5fd{position:relative;min-width:0;margin-left:-14px;padding:6px 6px 4px 28px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:pretty}
.w5a .w5fd > .t{hyphens:auto;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.w5a .w5fd::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:16px;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.42)}
.w5a .w5fd::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:16px;width:8px;top:15.5px;border-top:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.42)}
.w5a .w5fd.f1{padding-top:10px}
.w5a .w5fd.f1::after{top:19.5px}
.w5a .w5fd.fl{padding-bottom:11px}
.w5a .w5fd.fl::before{bottom:auto;height:15.5px}
.w5a .w5fd.fl.f1::before{height:19.5px}
.w5a .w5fd > .ld{position:absolute;right:0;top:15.5px;left:var(--ld,100%);border-top:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.42)}
.w5a .w5fd.f1 > .ld{top:19.5px}
.w5a .w5an{position:relative}
.w5a .w5an::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:6px;top:15.5px;border-top:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.42)}
.w5a .w5an::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:7px;top:12px;width:7px;height:7px;border-top:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.70);border-right:1.5px solid rgba(84,74,196,.70);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.w5a .w5an.f1::before{top:19.5px}
.w5a .w5an.f1::after{top:16px}
.w5a .w5an.nom::before,.w5a .w5an.nom::after,.w5a .w5fd.nom > .ld{display:none}
.w5a .w5m{min-width:0;max-width:360px;padding:6px 0 4px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.42;color:var(--ink-2);text-wrap:pretty}
.w5a .w5m.f1{padding-top:10px}
.w5a .w5m.fl{padding-bottom:11px}
.w5a .w5m b{font-weight:700}
.w5a .w5skip{margin:20px 2px 2px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink-2)}
.w5a .w5skip .w5z{display:block;margin:0 0 6px}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .w5a .w5b{grid-template-columns:112px 20px minmax(0,1fr)}
  .w5a .w5c{font-size:14.5px}
  .w5a .w5o{font-size:16px}
  .w5a .w5f{grid-template-columns:var(--w5-phone-find,120px) 20px minmax(0,1fr)}
  .w5a .w5fd{font-size:12.5px}
  .w5a .w5m{max-width:none}
}
/* Study mode (progressive recall): the clue stays; the test is a mask; the findings wait, blurred and inert,
   until that test is revealed (some findings name the test); then each meaning reveals on its own. */
body.study .w5a .w5f.w5-wait{filter:blur(5px);pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.w5a .w5f{transition:filter .22s}
.axm-flat .w5a .w5t,.axm-flat .w5a .w5t.first{box-shadow:var(--e2)}
.axm-flat .w5a .w5t.first{background:var(--raised)}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* Workup 5a connectors: start each finding's connector 6 px after the end of its first line. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function place(root){
    (root || document).querySelectorAll('.w5a .w5fd').forEach(function(fd){
      var t = fd.querySelector('.t'), ld = fd.querySelector('.ld'); if(!t || !ld) return;
      if(!document.createRange) return;
      var r = document.createRange(); if(typeof r.getClientRects !== 'function') return;   /* CSS fallback: connector from the column edge */
      r.selectNodeContents(t);
      var rects = r.getClientRects(); if(!rects || !rects.length) return;
      var first = rects[0], box = fd.getBoundingClientRect();
      for(var i = 1; i < rects.length; i++){ if(Math.abs(rects[i].top - first.top) < 2 && rects[i].right > first.right) first = rects[i]; }
      fd.style.setProperty('--ld', Math.round(first.right - box.left + 6) + 'px');
    });
  }
  /* Study mode: findings under a band wait until that band's test is revealed. */
  function gate(){
    var study = document.body.classList.contains('study');
    document.querySelectorAll('.w5a .w5b').forEach(function(b){
      var f = b.nextElementSibling; if(!f || !f.classList.contains('w5f')) return;
      var m = b.querySelector('.w5om'), wait = study && !(m && m.dataset.revealed === '1');
      if(f.classList.contains('w5-wait') !== wait) f.classList.toggle('w5-wait', wait);
      if(f.inert !== wait) f.inert = wait;
      if(wait) f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); else f.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
    });
  }
  var queued = false;
  function soon(){ if(queued) return; queued = true; requestAnimationFrame(function(){ queued = false; place(); gate(); }); }
  function init(){
    place();
    if(document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(soon);
    window.addEventListener('resize', soon);
    if(window.ResizeObserver){ var ro = new ResizeObserver(soon); document.querySelectorAll('.w5a').forEach(function(f){ ro.observe(f); }); }
    gate();
    new MutationObserver(soon).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    document.querySelectorAll('.w5a').forEach(function(f){ new MutationObserver(soon).observe(f, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-revealed'] }); });
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
})();
</script>
</body>
